items.question: How many professional levels does the UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) use to classify workers under the ISCO framework?
items.fact: MoHRE classifies workers into nine professional levels per ISCO.

items.question: What is the minimum monthly salary, excluding commission, that a worker must earn to be classified as skilled work under UAE MoHRE professional levels?
items.fact: Skilled work classification requires monthly salary, excluding commission, of at least AED 4,000.
